params.body:
The README, read against the code. Only stale claims corrected and missing essentials added; language and structure kept. Every change with the file and line that justifies it:

# README review: Trendwolves/gentells-site (commit 986debc)

Every change in README.new.md, with the file that justifies it.

## Stale claims corrected

- "php artisan test # 28 tests" -> 227 test methods in 45 files. `grep -rhoE "public function test_" tests | wc -l` = 227; `find tests -name '*Test.php' | wc -l` = 45.
- "CI runs the same two commands on every push and publishes coverage through `ShaneDeconinck/hub-quality@v1`" -> CI runs on push to `main` and on pull requests, with ESLint, Pint, tests with pcov coverage, PHP 8.5, Node 22, sqlite in memory, and publishes through `abovebeyond-ai/elixir-quality@v1`. `.github/workflows/test.yml` lines 8-11 (triggers), 21-24 (php 8.5, pcov), 33-35 (node 22), 51-53 (npm ci || npm install, build), 60-61 (ESLint), 64 (Pint), 68-72 (tests, clover), 77-81 (elixir-quality@v1).
- Deploy step 2.1 "a subdomain of abovebeyond.ai is simplest" -> the declared staging host is `https://gentells-site-6mym8kvk.on-forge.com`. `elixir.json` line 4.
- Deploy step 3 `ELIXIR_TOKEN=<matches /opt/hub-jobs/app-tokens/gentells-site>` -> `/home/elixir/elixir-secrets/app-tokens/gentells-site`. Source is outside this repo: workspace `~/Projects/CLAUDE.md`, section "Waar draait wat" (secrets moved from `/opt/hub-jobs/` to `/home/elixir/elixir-secrets/`, 2026-08-29). Flagged here because the brief asks for repo-only evidence.
- Deploy step 4 "npm ci && npm run build" -> "npm ci || npm install" then build, and the script lives in Forge outside the repo. `.github/workflows/test.yml` lines 40-49 (comment: "the same as deploy.sh") and `app/Elixir/BuildStamp.php` lines 10-11 ("the deploy script of a Forge site is outside the repo").

## Missing essentials added

- Intro: PHP 8.5 in CI and on the Forge box, composer allows ^8.3. `.github/workflows/test.yml` lines 21-24; `composer.json` line 9.
- "What this app owns": team accounts are projected from the Observatory (plan `intelligence`, flag `team`, revoked only for flagged rows). `app/Services/Projection.php` lines 289-355 (`reconcileTeam`); `app/Console/Commands/ReconcileProjection.php` line 24 (description names "team accounts"); `tests/Feature/TeamReconcileTest.php`.
- Rule 4 "Refuse a truncated source": max delete share 0.5, `ProjectionRefused`, empty team list refused. `config/gentells.php` (`max_delete_share`); `app/Services/Projection.php` line 138 and 311-312; `app/Exceptions/ProjectionRefused.php`.
- Reconcile schedule paragraph: every `GENTELLS_RECONCILE_MINUTES` (default 5), withoutOverlapping, runInBackground, sections independent, `ScheduleTest`. `routes/console.php` lines 8-11; `config/gentells.php` (`reconcile_minutes`); `app/Console/Commands/ReconcileProjection.php` lines 30-34; `tests/Feature/ScheduleTest.php`.
- Local development: `composer setup`, `npm run lint`, `npm run icons` (fontTools). `composer.json` scripts `setup`; `package.json` scripts; `bin/icons.mjs` lines 1-15.
- Reconcile flags `--articles`/`--trends` and the other artisan commands (`gentells:subscribers`, `gentells:report`, `gentells:clay-backfill`, `elixir:beat`). `app/Console/Commands/ReconcileProjection.php` lines 20-22; `app/Console/Commands/Subscribers.php` line 23; `IngestReport.php` line 25; `ClayBackfill.php` line 27; `app/Elixir/BeatCommand.php`.
- Tests block: added `npm run lint`. `.github/workflows/test.yml` line 61.
- New paragraph on `evidence.yml`: runs on PRs from `elixir/*` branches, `abovebeyond-ai/control-verify-action@v1`, mode pull. `.github/workflows/evidence.yml` lines 1-21.
- New section "What Elixir reads": `elixir.json` environments; `/up` outside the web group (`bootstrap/app.php` lines 14, 30-34); `/api/elixir` behind `ELIXIR_TOKEN` with `projection` extra and declared job `gentells:reconcile` every 15 minutes (`app/Elixir/ElixirServiceProvider.php` lines 41-46; `config/elixir.php`; `app/Elixir/ProjectionFreshness.php`); `/.well-known/build.json` public, from `.git/HEAD`, 404 without checkout (`app/Elixir/BuildStamp.php`; `tests/Feature/BuildStampTest.php`); `elixir:beat` every minute (`routes/console.php` lines 13-19).
- Deploy step 3 env: added `GENTELLS_RECONCILE_MINUTES`, `CURATION_EMAILS`, and a block of variables added since (Resend inbound, DMARC, billing/Stripe, premium flag, delete share, prelaunch), marking which are read in config but absent from `.env.example`. `.env.example` lines 80-117 (names only); `config/gentells.php` (`inbound.secret`, `inbound.api_key`, `dmarc_emails`, `billing`, `premium_requires_plan`, `max_delete_share`, `prelaunch`).
- Deploy step 6: `elixir:beat` proves the crontab line. `routes/console.php` lines 13-19; `config/elixir.php` trailing comment.

## Left as is (could not verify from the repo)

- "Ported from trendwolves/packages/app, which is still serving until the DNS cutover" and the whole "Still to do at cutover" section (DNS, reader-account migration, nginx backups on 178.104.3.200). Nothing in this repo says whether these happened. Note the tension: `elixir.json` already declares `https://gentells.com` as production, which is what Elixir measures.
- The Guzzle hold-back note: still true. `composer.lock`: guzzlehttp/guzzle 7.15.3, laravel/nightwatch 1.28.7 requires guzzlehttp/promises ^2.0.
- Nightwatch daemon and scheduler steps: consistent with `.env.example` comments and `routes/console.php`.
- Existing em dashes and arrows in the original text were not touched (style was not rewritten); none were added.

## Not in the repo

- No `CLAUDE.md`, no `elixir-fix.yml`, no deploy script. `.npmrc` was not read (blocked by the CC Safety Net rule `secret.basename.npmrc`).

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench.
params.title: README: read against the code
